source_summary: Chinese ink landscape with mist-wrapped mountains, layered wooded riverbanks, open water, a small boat with figures, and foreground groves and rocky shores. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: central_mist_wrapped_peak
motifs.description: Isolate the large dark central mountain mass with its rounded summit, sloping shoulders, and pale mist openings cutting through the lower slopes; exclude any nearby inscription or seals.
must_preserve: soft layered ink washes forming the broad peak
horizontal dry-brush texture across the summit and slopes
irregular pale mist gaps within the mountain body
feathered mountain edges dissolving into the surrounding air
dark-to-light wash gradations along the descending right slope

motifs.name: left_floating_mist_hills
motifs.description: Isolate the cluster of low dark hills at upper left-middle, separated by white mist channels and tapering into the central valley.
must_preserve: rounded low hill silhouettes
broken ink edges softened by mist
small dark knolls connected by faint wash
white negative-space mist passages between hill forms
subtle horizontal brush grain

motifs.name: right_distant_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the pale right-side mountain ridge and adjoining low dark foothills emerging from mist.
must_preserve: light gray wash ridge contour
soft diagonal slope rising at the far right
small darker foothill patches in front
misty base fading into open space
thin tonal transitions without hard outlines

motifs.name: midground_left_wooded_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the broad wooded riverbank across the middle-left, including dense tree crowns, trunks, shoreline washes, and low land forms.
must_preserve: layered foliage dabs in olive-gray and black ink
visible thin tree trunks and branching lines
dark foreground bank washes beneath the trees
pale yellow-green color accents in the foliage
horizontal shoreline strokes and watery reflections

motifs.name: midground_right_tree_screen
motifs.description: Isolate the narrower right-side riverside screen of trees and shrubs with its receding bank and pale water channel below.
must_preserve: vertical tree-trunk rhythm receding into depth
dark rounded foliage caps and lighter shrub washes
thin horizontal bank lines
pale water gaps between shore forms
subtle ocher-green wash accents

motifs.name: small_boat_with_figures
motifs.description: Isolate the small boat on the open water at lower left-middle, including the seated figures, arched covered load or canopy, and long narrow hull.
must_preserve: fine ink outline of the slender boat hull
tiny seated human figures at both ends
arched covered bundle or canopy at center
delicate pole or oar lines
large surrounding blank-water spacing immediately around the boat

motifs.name: foreground_willow_tree_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the foreground grove on the right and center, including dark broad-leaf trees, pale willow-like drooping branches, clustered trunks, and foliage masses along the river edge.
must_preserve: dark wet-ink leaf clusters with rounded brushstrokes
thin branching structure visible inside the foliage
drooping willow strands at the left edge of the grove
multiple pale trunks rising from the bank
green-gray and ocher wash accents layered behind darker leaves

motifs.name: lower_rocky_headland
motifs.description: Isolate the lower foreground headland with dark earth washes, exposed rounded rocks, small shoreline stones, and horizontal water-edge strokes; exclude signature and seals at the far right.
must_preserve: broad dark ink washes defining the sloped promontory
rounded rock clusters with darker contour strokes
dry-brush horizontal shoreline lines
small pale stones and broken bank edges
soft transitions from land into blank water

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
